answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 4 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. An operator running 146 keys thus pays for 146 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the sable quota and the crystal admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the umber ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
